goal: Make the real iteration manifest contract explicit, machine-validatable and dependency-free from iteration 50 onward

guide_delta.summary: Das Iterationsmanifest beschreibt ab I50 verbindlich Änderungstyp, Gate-Profil, Tests und das kleine Laienhilfe-Delta; fehlerhafte oder unvollständige V2-Manifeste werden vor den Zieltests blockiert.

tests_explicitly_not_run: full product suite because no product code changes
TUI regression because runtime is untouched
browser regression because web product code is untouched
database/domain/repository tests because frozen core is untouched
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: historical V1 manifests must remain readable and are deliberately grandfathered; V2 enforcement applies to the latest manifest from I50 onward
gate_profile is declarative in I50 and does not yet alter workflow routing; that remains I52
scope enforcement for meta paths remains unchanged until I51
non_changes: no workflow traffic-routing optimization in I50
expected_side_effects: future latest manifests must carry the V2 control fields before targeted tests execute
manifest validation fails fast before dependency installation or targeted test execution
template and machine-readable schema match the fields already used by current development practice
